msrpc.recommendation: Restrict RPC access to trusted networks.

microsoft-ds.recommendation: Block public SMB access unless required.

ftp.description: FTP may transmit credentials in plaintext.

ssh.description: SSH remote administration is reachable and should be reviewed for unintended public access.
ssh.recommendation: Restrict access to approved administrators and trusted networks; use key authentication and keep the service updated.

smtp.description: SMTP is reachable; mail relay permissions and transport encryption require review.
smtp.recommendation: Verify relay restrictions and authentication, enable TLS, and keep mail server software updated.

http.description: HTTP may carry unencrypted traffic or expose administrative interfaces, development pages, software versions, or configuration details.
http.recommendation: Redirect sensitive traffic to HTTPS; restrict management interfaces, review response headers and banners, and update vulnerable software.

netbios-ssn.description: NetBIOS session and Windows file sharing services are reachable.
netbios-ssn.recommendation: Block public file sharing access and restrict access to trusted networks and authorized users.

ms-wbt-server.description: Remote Desktop administration is reachable and may be exposed to untrusted clients.
ms-wbt-server.recommendation: Restrict RDP through a VPN or trusted gateway, require strong authentication, and keep the service updated.

rdp.description: Remote Desktop administration is reachable and may be exposed to untrusted clients.
rdp.recommendation: Restrict RDP through a VPN or trusted gateway, require strong authentication, and keep the service updated.

mysql.description: MySQL database or data store is reachable and may be unintentionally exposed.
mysql.recommendation: Restrict access to approved application hosts and trusted networks, require authentication, enable encryption where supported, and update vulnerable versions.

postgresql.description: PostgreSQL database or data store is reachable and may be unintentionally exposed.
postgresql.recommendation: Restrict access to approved application hosts and trusted networks, require authentication, enable encryption where supported, and update vulnerable versions.

redis.description: Redis database or data store is reachable and may be unintentionally exposed.
redis.recommendation: Restrict access to approved application hosts and trusted networks, require authentication, enable encryption where supported, and update vulnerable versions.

mongod.description: MongoDB database or data store is reachable and may be unintentionally exposed.
mongod.recommendation: Restrict access to approved application hosts and trusted networks, require authentication, enable encryption where supported, and update vulnerable versions.

mongodb.description: MongoDB database or data store is reachable and may be unintentionally exposed.
mongodb.recommendation: Restrict access to approved application hosts and trusted networks, require authentication, enable encryption where supported, and update vulnerable versions.

vnc.description: VNC remote desktop access is reachable and requires review of authentication and encryption.
vnc.recommendation: Restrict access through a VPN or trusted networks, require strong authentication, and use encrypted connections.

nfs.description: NFS file sharing is reachable and may expose exported files to untrusted clients.
nfs.recommendation: Restrict exports and network access to approved clients, review export permissions, and require appropriate authentication.

nfs_acl.description: NFS file sharing is reachable and may expose exported files to untrusted clients.
nfs_acl.recommendation: Restrict exports and network access to approved clients, review export permissions, and require appropriate authentication.

http-proxy.description: An alternative web or HTTPS service is reachable and may expose an administrative, proxy, or development interface.
http-proxy.recommendation: Verify the service is expected, restrict management access, disable unintended proxy access, review banners and software versions, and require HTTPS for sensitive traffic.

http-alt.description: An alternative web or HTTPS service is reachable and may expose an administrative, proxy, or development interface.
http-alt.recommendation: Verify the service is expected, restrict management access, disable unintended proxy access, review banners and software versions, and require HTTPS for sensitive traffic.

https-alt.description: An alternative web or HTTPS service is reachable and may expose an administrative, proxy, or development interface.
https-alt.recommendation: Verify the service is expected, restrict management access, disable unintended proxy access, review banners and software versions, and require HTTPS for sensitive traffic.

ssl/http.description: An alternative web or HTTPS service is reachable and may expose an administrative, proxy, or development interface.
ssl/http.recommendation: Verify the service is expected, restrict management access, disable unintended proxy access, review banners and software versions, and require HTTPS for sensitive traffic.

elasticsearch.description: An Elasticsearch search or data service is reachable and may expose stored data or management operations.
elasticsearch.recommendation: Restrict access to trusted application hosts, require authentication and TLS, and update vulnerable versions.

wap-wsp.description: A service is reachable on a port commonly used by Elasticsearch (9200), but this service label does not confirm Elasticsearch.
wap-wsp.recommendation: Identify the actual service and compare it with the expected configuration; if Elasticsearch is present, restrict access and require authentication and TLS.

docker.description: A Docker management API is reachable and may allow unencrypted or unrestricted container administration.
docker.recommendation: Disable unauthenticated TCP API access; use a local socket or authenticated TLS access restricted to trusted administrators.
